body.heading: Print your hands
paragraphs: Your adult spreads a little paint on the tray. Press your hand in, then press it onto the paper.
Green handprints with fingers up make grass and leaves. Round prints make flower heads.

body.heading: Grow the garden
paragraphs: Add stems, a sun, and maybe a bee with your fingertips when the paint is dry.
Sign your garden with one last tiny print in the corner.

takeaway: Your own hand can bloom into a whole garden.
materials: A tray or plate for paint
safetyNotes: An adult checks the paint is washable and safe for skin; wash hands well when you finish.
